codebook_question: Which types of renovations have been done since the year 2000 or since it was constructed? HVAC (heating, ventilation, or air conditioning) equipment upgrade?
assumption: HVAC controls and HVAC-side clauses re-dated to the renovation window; whether 90.1 alteration provisions carry each control clause to replaced equipment is decided per clause in Table C

codebook_question: Which types of renovations have been done since the year 2000 or since it was constructed? Lighting upgrade?
assumption: lighting controls re-dated to the renovation window; whether the lighting-alteration trigger was met is unknown (CBECS gives no share of fixtures replaced), so Table C states it per clause

codebook_question: Which types of renovations have been done since the year 2000 or since it was constructed? Electrical upgrade?
assumption: electrical-service clauses (metering / energy monitoring) re-dated to the renovation window; applicability of monitoring clauses to alterations decided in Table C
no system re-dated (an addition is new construction for its own area only; CBECS gives no area share)
